mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% indicates labor market slack that suppresses consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 40% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high industrial production (INDPRO > 95) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) indicate robust economic output and labor utilization, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances where INDPRO > 95 and UNRATE < 4.5.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a federal funds rate above 1.0% per annum compresses liquidity and raises discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in housing starts (HOUST) over the prior 3 months signals strong consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases by at least 1.0% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer price inflation exceeding 2.5% annually (CPIAUCSL > 2.5) signals monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, GDP growth exceeding 2.0% annually (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0%) indicates strong economic momentum that supports corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 100000) and high housing starts (HOUST > 700) indicate robust consumer spending and labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances where PAYEMS > 100000 and HOUST > 700.
